But at 101° C it becomes a gas, unpredictable, and following a different set of physical laws. Now, imagine you're an expert swimmer, perfect form in water. Then suddenly, the pool hits 101° C and it turns into steam. You try to swim, but you don't move. And every skill you've mastered was built for the old
